title: Spain: Andalusian Treasures
summary: Explore the heart of southern Spain on an 8-day journey through Andalusia’s most iconic cities. sections.title: Andalusian Treasures
sections.subtitle: Introduction
sections.html:
Andalusian Treasures

Explore the heart of southern Spain on an 8-day journey through Andalusia’s most iconic cities. Discover Málaga’s vibrant culture, Ronda’s dramatic landscapes, Seville’s historic grandeur, Córdoba’s Moorish heritage, Granada’s Alhambra, and the picturesque villages of the Alpujarras. Experience a blend of history, architecture, and culinary delights.

sections.title: Day 1 - Málaga: The Modern Capital of the Costa del Sol
sections.html:
Arrival at Málaga Airport

Arrival at Málaga Airport and welcome by the French-speaking tour director.

Transfer or Guided Visit

Depending on flight time, transfer to the hotel or enjoy a guided introductory visit to Málaga or Mijas.

Guided Introductory Visit to Málaga

Discover Málaga’s Roman theater, two medieval fortresses, covered market, lively pedestrian shopping streets, renowned museums (Picasso, Thyssen, Pompidou), and the boutiques and restaurants of its revitalized marina.

Visit to Mijas

Mijas: This picturesque hillside white village overlooks the Costa del Sol. On clear days, Gibraltar is visible from its gardens. Wander flower-lined streets, see the donkey taxis and the Virgin of the Rock sanctuary, and browse local crafts.

Dinner

Dinner and overnight: Hotel in the Algeciras area.

Hotel in the Algeciras area

Overnight at a hotel in the Algeciras area.

sections.title: Day 2 - Ronda: A Jewel in the Heart of the Mountains
sections.html:
Guided tour of Ronda’s stone bullring and Bullfighting Museum

Guided tour of Ronda’s stone bullring and Bullfighting Museum. Cross the Puente Nuevo over the gorge and explore the old town’s whitewashed lanes.

Visit Casa Don Bosco

Visit Casa Don Bosco, an Art Nouveau-style mansion with gardens overlooking the gorge.

Tapas lunch in central Ronda

Tapas lunch in central Ronda.

Drive toward Cádiz province around the Grazalema Mountains

Drive toward Cádiz province around the Grazalema Mountains, one of Spain’s rainiest areas.

Stop in Zahara de la Sierra

Stop in Zahara de la Sierra, a designated historic village with a square, church, chapel, clock tower and castle ruins above the valley (castle admission not included).

Dinner

Dinner and overnight: Costa de la Luz or Algeciras area.

Hotel in Costa de la Luz or Algeciras area

Overnight at a hotel in the Costa de la Luz or Algeciras area.

sections.title: Day 3 - Jerez: Andalusia's Capital of Wine and Horses
sections.html:
Guided visit to González Byass / Tío Pepe winery

Guided visit to the González Byass / Tío Pepe winery, established in 1835, including a sherry tasting.

Guided visit to the Royal Andalusian School of Equestrian Art

Guided visit to the Royal Andalusian School of Equestrian Art, including stables, saddlery, palace rooms, equestrian museum, carriage collection and a daily horse-training session.

Lunch at a picturesque restaurant

Lunch at a picturesque restaurant.

Late-afternoon arrival in Seville

Late-afternoon arrival in Seville; introductory walking or coach tour, according to available time.

Optional: Fighting bull ranch visit

Guided visit to a traditional fighting bull ranch in the dehesa countryside, learning about breeding and selection. €35 per person, plus €4 per person for groups smaller than 25.

Dinner

Dinner and overnight: Hotel near Seville.

Hotel near Seville

Overnight at a hotel near Seville.

sections.title: Day 4 - Seville: Andalusia's Dazzling Capital
sections.html:
Guided panoramic coach tour

Guided panoramic coach tour: Murillo Gardens, former Royal Tobacco Factory (now university), Tower of Gold, Maestranza Bullring and Paseo de las Delicias with pavilions from the 1929 Ibero-American Exposition.

Walking tour of Santa Cruz

Walking tour of Santa Cruz, the old Jewish Quarter, with orange-tree squares, cobbled lanes, tiled patios and flower-filled houses.

Visit Seville Cathedral and Giralda

Visit Seville Cathedral, one of the largest Gothic cathedrals in the world, and see the Giralda, originally the minaret of the former mosque.

Traditional lunch in central Seville

Traditional lunch in central Seville.

Walk through María Luisa Park and Plaza de España

Walk through María Luisa Park and admire Plaza de España, its grand architecture and ceramic panels representing Spain’s provinces.

Optional: Royal Alcázar admission, independent visit

Royal Alcázar admission, independent visit: €16.50 per person (2026 rate).

Optional: Short Guadalquivir River cruise

Short Guadalquivir River cruise: €14.50 per person.

Optional: Ceramic tile workshop

Ceramic tile workshop: discover the history of Seville’s azulejos and Triana ceramic decoration, then decorate your own tile. Approximately 2–2.5 hours, maximum 25–30 people; price on request.

Optional: Spanish fan workshop

Spanish fan workshop: explore the history and symbolism of fans, including their former “language of love,” then decorate your own fan. Approximately 2–2.5 hours, maximum 25–30 people; price on request.

Dinner

Dinner and overnight: Hotel in Seville.

Hotel in Seville

Overnight at a hotel in Seville.

sections.title: Day 5 - Córdoba and Costa Tropical Discovery
sections.html:
Travel to Córdoba

Travel to Córdoba and take a guided tour of the Mosque–Cathedral, a former great mosque converted to a cathedral after 1236, with Umayyad, Gothic, Renaissance and Baroque architectural elements.

Guided tour of the Mosque–Cathedral

Guided tour of the Mosque–Cathedral, a former great mosque converted to a cathedral after 1236, with Umayyad, Gothic, Renaissance and Baroque architectural elements.

Walk through the Judería

Walk through the Judería, the historic Jewish Quarter, home to a 14th-century synagogue.

Tapas lunch in central Córdoba

Tapas lunch in central Córdoba.

Visit a family olive oil mill

On the way to the Costa Tropical, visit a family olive oil mill. Learn the production process, view historical machinery, watch an audiovisual presentation and enjoy a tasting.

Hotel in Almuñécar or Salobreña

Check in to the hotel and enjoy a welcome sangria. Dinner and overnight: Almuñécar or Salobreña.

sections.title: Day 6 - Granada: The City of Sultans
sections.html:
Guided visit to the Alhambra

Guided visit to the Alhambra, including the intricately decorated Nasrid palaces, courtyards and fountains, Generalife summer residence and gardens, and Charles V Palace.

Paella lunch in Sierra Nevada foothills

Paella lunch at a restaurant in the Sierra Nevada foothills overlooking the Granada plain.

Walk through the Albaicín

Walk with the tour director through the Albaicín, the old Moorish neighborhood, with whitewashed lanes and views of the Alhambra and Sierra Nevada.

Free time in the Alcaicería

Free time in the Alcaicería, Granada’s historic market area.

Important Alhambra ticket conditions

Dinner

Dinner and overnight: Almuñécar or Salobreña.

Hotel in Almuñécar or Salobreña

Overnight at a hotel in Almuñécar or Salobreña.

sections.title: Day 7 - The Alpujarras: A Culinary Journey Through the Sierra Nevada
sections.html:
Travel into the Alpujarras mountains

Travel into the mountains with the tour director. At elevations above 1,200 meters, local conditions favor traditional ham curing.

Visit a ham-curing facility

Visit a ham-curing facility and taste regional charcuterie, cheeses and a glass of wine.

Traditional mountain lunch

Enjoy a traditional mountain lunch.

Explore villages such as Pampaneira

Explore picturesque villages such as Pampaneira, with distinctive architecture, narrow lanes and artisan shops.

Optional adjustment: earlier return to Almuñécar

Arrange an earlier return to Almuñécar for the beach, seaside promenade or more time in town.

Dinner

Dinner and overnight: Almuñécar or Salobreña.

Hotel in Almuñécar or Salobreña

Overnight at a hotel in Almuñécar or Salobreña.

sections.title: Day 8 - Almuñécar to Málaga: Departure
sections.html:
Transfer to Málaga Airport

Transfer to Málaga Airport, with assistance at check-in, for the return flight. Depending on flight time, additional sightseeing or lunch at a hotel or restaurant can be arranged at extra cost upon request.
